attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id, s.name AS method_name
FROM code.class_bases cb
JOIN code.symbols base ON base.symbol_id = cb.base_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols cls ON cls.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cls.file_id
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.enclosing_class_symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
WHERE base.qualname = 'SQLDatabase'
  AND base.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py'
  AND base.kind = 'class'
  AND cls.kind = 'class'
  AND cf.is_test = FALSE
  AND cf.file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%'
  AND cf.file_id NOT LIKE 'tests/%'
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND s.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols m
    WHERE m.enclosing_class_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
      AND m.kind = 'method'
      AND m.name = s.name
  )
ORDER BY cb.class_symbol_id, s.name

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: Finds classes whose direct base resolves to the SQLDatabase class defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py, restricted to non-test files (excluding any path under a tests/ folder). For each such class it lists methods defined directly in the class body whose names do not start with an underscore and that SQLDatabase does not itself define as a method.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name
FROM code.class_bases cb
JOIN code.symbols base ON base.symbol_id = cb.base_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols cls ON cls.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cls.file_id
JOIN code.symbol_profile m ON m.enclosing_class_symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id
WHERE base.qualname = 'SQLDatabase'
  AND base.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py'
  AND base.kind = 'class'
  AND cls.kind = 'class'
  AND cf.is_test = FALSE
  AND cf.file_id NOT LIKE '%/tests/%'
  AND cf.file_id NOT LIKE 'tests/%'
  AND m.kind = 'method'
  AND m.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM code.symbol_profile bm
    WHERE bm.enclosing_class_symbol_id = base.symbol_id
      AND bm.kind = 'method'
      AND bm.name = m.name
  )
ORDER BY cb.class_symbol_id, m.name
